We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The case: Zhang fabricated company info, signed contracts, collected guarantee deposits (security) from victims, total 2.04 million RMB, gave 820k to the other company, rest he spent. He disappeared. This is fraud (诈骗) – specifically contract fraud, obtaining guarantee deposits by false pretenses. In Chinese criminal law, this is "诈骗罪". Also possibly "非法占有" but that's part of fraud. Could also be "非法集资"? No, it's not public offering. It's fraud via contract. Also maybe "伪造公司资料" but that's not a separate crime unless forging documents. The examples: For similar case of fraudulent contract and guarantee deposit, they used "诈骗". Example: first example: fraud plus prostitution crimes. But here only fraud. So answer: 诈骗.

Check if any other crimes: "非法占有" is part of fraud. No other. So output: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
